scheduler: No repository cron scheduler. GitHub Actions runs on relevant ingestion code pushes and workflow_dispatch; periodic discovery cadence is caller/automation-owned.
jobicy_fallback_policy: REST primary; public RSS fallback is limited to expected transport failures or malformed provider payloads. Unexpected adapter/programming errors fail visibly. Optional targeted HEAD checks treat only 404/410 as closed.
technical_state: separate GitHub radar-state and ingestion-state branches + SQLite; shared workflow_state helper owns ACK normalization/merge and review queue handoff preparation
first_seen_radar: isolated direct employer/ATS first-seen workflow available on relevant push/manual dispatch + persistent ingestion_change=new semantics + bootstrap-safe 72-hour ACK queue
vacancy_snapshot_history: SQLite job_snapshots keyed by job_id + content_hash
semantic_review_handoff: at-least-once persistent ACK queue + Config-owned priority-hint triage + bounded 25-item pages + backlog telemetry; final semantic verification remains vacature-search-owned
register_sync: configured service-account read gate + ingestion Bronnen source-health + compact Runs row; radar state stays isolated
target_runtime_gate: GitHub Actions live ingestion and first-seen radar after repository-triggered or manually dispatched run
release_evidence: deterministic source bundle + SPDX SBOM + GitHub provenance/SBOM attestations
queue_worker_scope: Technical priority-hint triage only. Live Config owns terms/employers; nonpriority ingestion hints are acknowledged only from this optimization queue while mandatory normal discovery/expansion remains unchanged. No authenticity, hard-gate, fit, score, source-priority or application decision is made by ingestion.
review_triage_evidence: review-triage.json persisted on ingestion-state with input, priority-pending, auto-acked nonpriority, policy version and fail-closed missing-key counts.
